SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8299/14
S.1. Special Branch / Station 26 / 38
REPORT
Date July 24, 1938

Subject Assistance to Japanese Military Police.

Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C. Crawford W.J

At 10.40 a.m. 23.7.38, Sergeant Major Katohda,
Mr. Sera and Mr. Okazaki of the Japanese Military Police
Headquarters, Bridge House, came to Special Branch, Head-
quarters, with an envelope bearing the following address:-
"War of Resistance Intelligence Office (抗戰情報社),
Room 510 Continental Building, Nanking Road, which had
been seized by the Japanese Censorship Bureau in the
General Post Office, North Szechuen Road on 22.7.38. The
contents of the letter was neither produced nor divulged
by the Military Police. At the request of the Japanese
Military Police, assistance was rendered by members of the
Special Branch together with D.S.I. Tuck and C.D.S. 12
attached to Central to search Room 510 aforesaid. A
Chinese song book entitled "Ta 大眾歌聲 Tsoong Koo Sung" (songs of
the public), containing songs of an anti-Japanese nature
was all that was found. This book was seized and detained
at Special Branch, Headquarters. The room in question was
rented by one Koo Shih Tzi (顧變之) age about 30,
Soochow, formerly employed in the Continental Bank, but
at present employed in the Japanese sponsored Kiangsu
Provincial District Bank at Soochow. Koo Shih Tzi
together with his wife Zung Ku Ying (陳冠英), left
Shanghai for Soochow early on the morning of 23.7.38.
One Zung Cheu Tzi (陳久之) alias Zung Tso Wen (陳祖恒)
brother of Zung Ku Ying, who was found in the room, was,
at the request of the Japanese brought to Central Station
for interrogation regarding the aforesaid "War of Resistance
Intelligence Office" but denied all knowledge of same.
The Japanese Military Police did not return to Central

档案号 8299/14
S.1. 特别分部 / 第26巡捕房 / 38
报告
日期：1938年7月24日

主题：协助日本宪兵队。

呈报人：副督察长（D.S.I.）洛根（Logan） 转呈人：C. Crawford W.J

1938年7月23日上午10时40分，日本宪兵队总部（位于百老汇大厦）的加藤田（Katohda，音译）军曹长、世良（Sera，音译）先生和冈崎（Okazaki，音译）先生来到特别分部总部，携带一个信封，信封上写有以下地址：“抗战情报社，南京路大陆商场510室”，该信件已于1938年7月22日被北四川路邮政总局的日本检查局扣押。宪兵队既未出示也未透露信件内容。应日本宪兵队的请求，特别分部成员会同配属中央巡捕房的副督察长（D.S.I.）塔克（Tuck）和第12号华籍侦探警长（C.D.S. 12）提供了协助，搜查了上述510室。除发现一本名为《大众歌声》（Ta Tsoong Koo Sung）的中文歌本，内含反日性质的歌曲外，未发现其他物品。该书已被扣押并留存于特别分部总部。涉案房间由顾变之（Koo Shih Tzi，约30岁，苏州人，原任职于大陆银行，现任职于日军扶持的位于苏州的江苏省区银行）租用。顾变之与其妻陈冠英（Zung Ku Ying）已于1938年7月23日清晨离开上海前往苏州。在房间内发现的陈久之（Zung Cheu Tzi），又名陈祖恒（Zung Tso Wen），系陈冠英之弟，应日方要求被带至中央巡捕房，就上述“抗战情报社”一事接受讯问，但他否认知晓此事。日本宪兵队并未返回中央

（左侧页边批注：x D 8594）
（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ... 1/2 ...）

Station but mentioned to D.S. Kamashita that they had no
objection to Zung Cheu Tzi being released, should no
information be forthcoming. He was accordingly released
at 12.40 p.m., 23.7.38 upon a guarantee being furnished by
his brother Zung Yang Yui( 陳養餘), 11 Cheng Tuh Li,
off Chekiang Road, employed as an accountant by the Dah
Tung Flour Company.

        Two passes issued by the Japanese Special Service
Corps in favour of Zung Zee Sz( 陳徐氏) and Woo Sz Fong
( 吳樹芳), mother and cousin respectively of Zung Cheu
Tzi, aforesaid, permitting them to travel to Soochow as
well as two name cards bearing the name of Zia Tien Woo
( 謝天枢) were brought to Central Station but were later
returned to Zung Cheu Tzi.

        It would appear that the letter seized by the
Japanese was posted by some person who knew that Koo Shih Tzi
had taken up a position with a Japanese sponsored Bank, with
the intention to have him suspected by the Japanese, as
it seems highly improbable that an organ like "War of Resis-
tance Intelligence Office" would openly use such an address.

两张由日本特务机关签发、允许上述陈久之的母亲陈徐氏（Zung Zee Sz）和表亲吴树芳（Woo Sz Fong）前往苏州的通行证，以及两张印有谢天枢（Xia Tien Woo）姓名的名片被带至中央巡捕房，但随后归还给了陈久之。

看来，被日本人扣押的信件是由某个知道顾变之已在日军扶持的银行任职的人寄出的，目的是使顾变之受到日本人的怀疑，因为像“抗战情报社”这样的机构公开使用此类地址似乎极不可能。

1938年7月23日上午10时40分，中央巡捕房高级侦探警司（D.I.）泰尔弗（Telfer）指派第12号华籍侦探警长（C.D.S. 12）和具名者，陪同上海公共租界工部局警务处特别分部的副督察长（D.S.I.）洛根（Logan）及一队日本宪兵，前往一处他们需要搜查特定场所的地址。

第12号华籍侦探警长和具名者到场后获悉，在1938年7月22日期间，邮政总局检查局的成员截获了一封寄往“南京路大陆商场510室抗战办公室”的中文信件，因此，1938年7月23日上午10时，日本宪兵队总部（百老汇大厦）的加藤田（Katohda，音译）军曹长在萨拉（Sara，音译）先生和大屋（Oyaki，音译）先生的陪同下，前往上海公共租界工部局警务处特别分部总部，持有写有上述地址的信封，请求协助突袭相关地点并搜查该场所。

在提供协助期间，一名提供以下个人资料的华裔男子：

陈久子（Sung Chau Tsze），又名陈祖维（Sung Tse We），21岁，苏州人，学生，

被要求带至巡捕房以作进一步查问。

查获一本反日歌本和两张名片。

The above male when questioned denied any knowledge or connection with any activities of an Anti-Japanese nature, but explained that his brother-in-law named Koo Shih Tsze (顧詩子), 30,Soochow, formerly a clerk employed in the Continental Bank, Nanking Road, until the end of May or commencement June 1938 and had resided together with his wife and family inside Room No. 510 of the Continental Emporium Building, Nanking Road, had together with his family left Shanghai today (23-7-38) to proceed to Soochow to take up an employment with the Kiangsu Provisional District Bank,Soochow, this bank being sponsored by the Japanese Military Authorities. It therefore appears that the letter was addressed to Room No. 501 by possibly some person of pro-Chinese Nationalist Government sympathies due to the brother-in-law having obtained employment in the above capacity.

The contents of the letter seized by the Censorship Bureau was not disclosed, nor did the members of the Japanese Military Headquarters return to this Station after searching the room concerned, they only requesting that the apprehended male be questioned regarding the letter and if any information likely to be of use to the persons concerned was obtained same was to be communicated to them, and if nothing of use was obtained the apprehended male was to be released.

The apprehended male denying all knowledge of the

信件及其含义的知识，随后收到特别分部警司（D.I.）克劳福德（Crawford）的指示，大意是需找到一位可靠人士，为该男子的责任承担担保，并在再次需要时确保其到案。

鉴于上述情况，找到了被捕男子的兄长陈养銓（Aung Yang Yue，浙江路正德里11号大同面粉公司会计师），他来到本巡捕房，并表示愿意为被捕男子担任担保人。

因此，该男子于1938年7月27日（原文如此，前文为23日）下午12时40分从拘留中获释，被扣押的书籍和两张名片由副督察长（D.S.I.）洛根（Logan）带走，送至特别分部办公室进行检查。

〔签名〕
高级侦探主管。

W. Luck
副督察长（D. S. I.）
